strings.en: Don't come here with half-baked resolve!
I've got no intention of losing to you!
I can't waste time in a place like this!
Show them your power, Leonysis Harga!
You're in the Leonysis Harga's range!
We're both Leonysis. The basics don't change!
I've got no reason to put up with your grudges!
Let's settle this with no hard feelings, Jua-Mu!
I'll beat that guy and break through here!
Every planet's got some guy plotting a dictatorship!
If you want to play emperor, get through us first!
You and I were fated to end up like this, Iradoya!
Whatever machine you bring out,/　I'll trample it!
Gomoudokka Golaikunru.../　If I can beat him...!
I'd rather not fight those guys if I can help it...!
I won't aim for the cockpit...!
I can't deal a fatal blow...!
I'm ending this fight! Don't get in my way!
Back off! I don't want to fight you guys!
No choice. Without aiming for the cockpit...!
Against Captain Vort,/　I can't let my guard down for a second!
Captain, I've got no intention of obeying Herluga!
Captain Vort, we're going to the Rabulpaila!
If you know the truth, tell me, Captain!
I won't let you stall us! Reggiane!
I never liked you from the start, Bilgo!
Do you have any idea how many/　have been sacrificed because of you?!
Gadisword's future.../　I won't hand it to you of all people!
I'll put a stop to that laugh, Debudedabide!
I'll beat him before he uses his weird tricks!
He's a joke of a guy, but I can't let my guard down!
So on this planet, Dragous actually exist...!
I'm not about to become your prey!
If you're gonna turn tail and run, now's your chance!
Skull Knight! I'll smash you, armor and all!
So that's another disaster from the Cross Gate...!
If Gadisword's future is at stake,/　there's only one thing to do!
Zovorg mobile weapons don't scare me!
I'll shoot down that Zovorg unit!
With all the data in hand, it's easier to deal with!
If it's Golaikunru, I won't hold back!
I can't let anyone helping Herluga slide!
Even if it's a commander unit!
Thicken that barrage all you want, it's useless!
If I can just get in close...!
Is that some kind of bio-weapon...?!
Whatever kind of Lamaris it is, I can't let it run loose!
Damn Lamaris... How big are you gonna get?!
Not that I think you can talk to a thing like that!
I've gotta get that thing off the Cross Gate!
This is what happens when you fail to finish me!
If you're just feeling me out, it's useless!
I owe you some thanks for attacking me!
I won't let you go home like this!
I won't fall! I'm the one who wins in the end!
You've done it now! I've had it with you!
Damn it! I'm getting pushed around. Pathetic!
As long as my machine moves, I'll keep fighting!
I can't kick the bucket here!
I-I'm lucky I didn't get shot down...
Damn it! What did you do to my Leonysis!
Show me your true potential, Varga!
Damn you, Jua-Mu, you got me!
I-I'm not handing you my head,/　Karo-Ran!
Ngh! So this is/　the power of the Zee-Gadin?!
If I die here,/　I'll go down as nothing but a traitor...!
N-Now that he's my enemy, I get it.../　how strong the Captain is!
Damn it! I'm one step away from Herluga!
Like hell I'll become that woman's prey!
Ngh! Damn Herluga, she's out of control!
I held my ground... Skull Knight!
Nice work, but it's not a fatal blow!
That just gave me a reason to fire myself up again!
Huh, you're better than I thought.
Interesting! You've got a little backbone!
Ngh, the damage is starting to add up...!
If you think this'll make me flinch, you're dead wrong!
So you bit into the Leonysis Harga!
Sorry, Sally. The Varga got scratched.
I know it's natural I'm the target, but...!
I've just gotta weather this somehow...!
Even if they slander me as a traitor,/　there's something I have to do...!
This fight isn't over yet, Karo-Ran!
Looks like the Knight Commander title/　isn't just for show...!
Damn you, Gomoudokka! Don't get cocky!
Don't think you can beat me, Bilgo!
It's the Captain... I was ready for this much!
No matter how mighty Floraga's power is!
Damn you, Debudedabide, quit fooling around!
Just wait...! I'll smash that body of yours for sure!
Damn you, XN-L, I won't let you do any more!
Interesting! I'll go all the way with you, Fury!
Don't come at me with half-baked attacks!
A hit's a hit. I'll pay you back properly!
You think that'll shoot me down? Don't make me laugh.
Tch, I didn't dodge in time!
Can't believe I got hit by that...!
Like that's enough to stop my Harga!
Like that could pierce the Varga's armor!
Calling yourself emperor with that? What a joke!
Tch! That woman pisses me off!
If you're in that sorry state,/　your Royal Guard can't be much!
This is the Captain.../　He must have another move ready!
Getting that worked up will age you faster, Reggiane!
Herluga! I won't let you stall!
That smirking face really ticks me off!
Damn Dragous, it landed a hit!
Did I misjudge the Skull Knight's range...!
Like hell I'll be overpowered by a Kaana type!
Falling for a basic feint like that!
Attacks like that won't work on the Leonysis Harga!
Pathetic attack for someone who talks so big,/　Gu-Landon!
Like hell I'll fall for that woman's tricks!
Bilgo, you think you can beat me?!
Even if it's you, I won't back down!
Reggiane! Don't think you can stop us!
Like I'd hand the Cross Gate over to you!
I'm not playing along with your cheap magic tricks!
XN-L!/　I've got no intention of quietly letting you destroy us!
I won't fall behind a Zovorg unit!
You may have firepower, but you're way too sloppy!
Like hell I'll let some Lamaris bite into me!
It may have gotten big, but it's still just a Lamaris!
Looks like you can't keep up with the Harga!
That Raftclans doesn't give an inch...!
Your aim wasn't bad, you know?
Ngh, none of my weapons can be used...!
Moving in to support the Super Soul Saber!
Fairy, I'll take it from here!
Sally, leave the rest to me!
Captain Vort, leave the rest to me!
Didn't expect me to show up, did you?!
This isn't like you, Captain Vort!
I'll take care of you all at once!
Letting me follow up? Too naive!
Now, let's go out with a bang!
At this distance, it's Short Range Mode!
I'll make this quick and shoot!
I'll finish this in one go!
Bunched up like that, you're a great target!
I'll take you all out at once!
I'll show you the Grungust's finishing move!
Told you it was a finishing move, didn't I?
I'll finish this with one blow...!
If I can just get close...!
This thing's tackle is no joke!
No use running, wherever you go!
Don't think you can read this!
It takes more than that to stop me!
It works just like the Slicer Haken!
Hmph, you're no match for me!
I'll cut you down with this!
That had a nice edge to it.
I'm good at slugging it out!
That's way past cut in two.
I'll hit you with every gun!
I'll show you this thing's trump card!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Hmph, guess I got a little carried away...
I know you're actually a klutz, you know~?
What I have to do is simple!
I'll show you how sharp this is!
I'm staking it all on this!
Ora ora! I won't give you a chance to strike back!!
Can you keep up with this speed?!
Ora ora! You've got nowhere to run!!
With this thing's range and speed!
I can pound in everything I've got!
